```{r}
# Loading data

# P-tau181 data

# Diagnosis data

# Demographics data

demographics <- PTDEMOG

apoe <- APOERES
```

```{r}
# checking observations with more than one measurement recorded on the same exam date for nfl
nfl_double <- nfl_data %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .by = c(RID, EXAMDATE)) %>%
  filter(n > 1L) %>%
  select(RID, EXAMDATE)

# removing the doubled observations
nfl_data <- nfl_data %>%
  group_by(RID, EXAMDATE) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# checking observations with more than one measurement recorded on the same exam date for ptau
ptau_double <- ptau_data %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .by = c(RID, EXAMDATE)) %>%
  filter(n > 1L)  %>%
  select(RID, EXAMDATE)

# extracting the doubled observations
# ptau_data %>%
#    filter(RID %in% ptau_double$RID) %>% 
#    filter(EXAMDATE %in% ptau_double$EXAMDATE)

# removing the doubled observations
ptau_data <- ptau_data %>%
  group_by(RID, EXAMDATE) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# We select the required nfl variables
nfl_data <- nfl_data %>%
  select(RID, VISCODE2, EXAMDATE, PLASMA_NFL)

# We select the required ptau variables
ptau_data <- ptau_data %>%
  select(RID, VISCODE2, EXAMDATE, PLASMAPTAU181)

# We select the required diagnosis variables
diagnosis_data <- diagnosis_data %>%
  select(ORIGPROT, COLPROT, RID, VISCODE2, EXAMDATE, DIAGNOSIS)

# We add _dx on the diagnosis variables 
diagnosis_data_dx <- diagnosis_data %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_dx"), -c(RID, VISCODE2))

# We merge NFL, ptau and diagnosis data for longitudinal data by RID and VISCODE2
long_data <- nfl_data %>%
  left_join(ptau_data, by = c("RID", "VISCODE2"), suffix = c("_nfl", "_ptau")) %>%
  left_join(diagnosis_data_dx, by = c("RID", "VISCODE2"))

# We merge NFL, ptau and diagnosis data for survival data, only by RID 
surv_data <- nfl_data %>%
  left_join(ptau_data, by = c("RID", "VISCODE2"), suffix = c("_nfl", "_ptau")) %>%
  left_join(diagnosis_data_dx, by = c("RID"))
```

```{r}
# We remove missing values 
long_data <- na.omit(long_data)
surv_data <- na.omit(surv_data)

# We re-count missing values
sapply(long_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
sapply(surv_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
```

```{r}
# We only keep the demographics variables we need and one row per person 
demographics_small <- demographics %>%
  select(RID, PTDOBYY, PTGENDER) %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# We create a variable for apoe4 status
#apoe$APOE4_status <- ifelse(apoe$GENOTYPE %in% c("2/4","3/4","4/4"), 1, 0)

# We define APOE4 status based on number of E4 alleles
apoe <- apoe %>%
  mutate(APOE4_status = case_when(
    GENOTYPE == "4/4" ~ "2 alleles",
    GENOTYPE %in% c("2/4", "3/4") ~ "1 allele",
    TRUE ~ "0 alleles"
  ))

# We merge gender with merged_data and surv_data
long_data <- long_data %>%
  left_join(demographics_small, by = "RID")
surv_data <- surv_data %>%
  left_join(demographics_small, by = "RID")

# We merge apoe4 status with merged_data and surv_data
long_data <- merge(long_data, apoe[, c("RID", "APOE4_status")], by="RID")
surv_data <- merge(surv_data, apoe[, c("RID", "APOE4_status")], by="RID")

# We make sure that gender and apoe4 status are factors
long_data$PTGENDER <- as.factor(long_data$PTGENDER)
surv_data$PTGENDER <- as.factor(surv_data$PTGENDER)
long_data$APOE4_status <- factor(long_data$APOE4_status,
                            levels = c("0 alleles", "1 allele", "2 alleles"))
surv_data$APOE4_status <- factor(surv_data$APOE4_status,
                            levels = c("0 alleles", "1 allele", "2 alleles"))

# We create age_at_visit 
long_data$age_at_visit <- as.numeric(format(long_data$EXAMDATE_ptau, "%Y")) - long_data$PTDOBYY
surv_data$age_at_visit <- as.numeric(format(surv_data$EXAMDATE_ptau, "%Y")) - surv_data$PTDOBYY
```

```{r}
# We filter individuals with at least 3 measurements of ptau_data
keep = unique((ptau_data %>% group_by(RID) %>% filter(n() > 2))$RID)
long_data <- long_data %>% filter(RID %in% keep)
surv_data <- surv_data %>% filter(RID %in% keep)

# We check number of individuals with at least 3 measurements 
length(keep)
```

```{r}
long_data[-common, ]

merged_data <- long_data %>%

common = which(long_data$EXAMDATE_nfl %in% long_data$EXAMDATE_ptau)

# checking the observations with different exam dates (9 obs)
long_data[-common, ]

# dates aren't too different, and only one observation at baseline, but to be sure create the baseline date out of the earlier of the two dates
long_data <- long_data %>%
```

```{r}
# We log transform the biomarkers 
long_data$log_PLASMAPTAU181 <- log(long_data$PLASMAPTAU181)
long_data$log_PLASMA_NFL <- log(long_data$PLASMA_NFL)

surv_data$log_PLASMAPTAU181 <- log(surv_data$PLASMAPTAU181)
surv_data$log_PLASMA_NFL <- log(surv_data$PLASMA_NFL)
```

```{r}
core <- surv_data %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    
    # Baseline = first observed biomarker
    baseline = min(c(EXAMDATE_ptau, EXAMDATE_nfl), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Age at baseline 
    age_at_baseline = age_at_visit[
      EXAMDATE_ptau == baseline |
      EXAMDATE_nfl  == baseline 
    ][1],
    
    # First dementia diagnosis after baseline
    event_date = {
      dx_dates <- EXAMDATE_dx[DIAGNOSIS_dx == "Dementia"]
      dx_dates <- dx_dates[!is.na(dx_dates)]
      dx_dates <- dx_dates[dx_dates > baseline]
      
      if (length(dx_dates) == 0) as.Date(NA) else min(dx_dates)
    },
    
    # Last follow-up across all sources
    last_followup = max(c(EXAMDATE_ptau, EXAMDATE_nfl, EXAMDATE_dx), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    # Event indicator
    event = as.integer(!is.na(event_date)),
    
    # Time-to-event
    time_to_event = if_else(
      event == 1,
      as.numeric(event_date - baseline) / 365.25,
      as.numeric(last_followup - baseline) / 365.25
    )
  )

# We keep one row per participant and attach all original variables
surv_data <- surv_data %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(core, by = "RID")

# We tabulate the ptau event indicator (1 = dementia, 0 = censored)
table(surv_data$event)
```

```{r}
long_data <- long_data %>%
  left_join(core %>% select(RID, baseline), by = "RID") %>%
  
  mutate(
    time_years_ptau = as.numeric(EXAMDATE_ptau - baseline) / 365.25,
    time_years_nfl  = as.numeric(EXAMDATE_nfl  - baseline) / 365.25
  )
```

```{r}
# Longitudinal model for p-tau181 with normal distribution 
long_model_ptau <- lme(
  fixed = log_PLASMAPTAU181 ~ time_years_ptau + PTGENDER + APOE4_status,
  random = ~ time_years_ptau | RID,                    
  data = long_data
)

summary(long_model_ptau)

# Longitudinal model for NfL with normal distribution 
long_model_nfl <- lme(
  log_PLASMA_NFL ~ time_years_nfl + PTGENDER + APOE4_status, 
  random = ~ time_years_nfl | RID, # random intercept + slope
  data = long_data
  )

summary(long_model_nfl)
```

```{r}
# We create a Surv object: time and event
surv_object <- Surv(
  time = surv_data$time_to_event, 
  event = surv_data$event
)
```

```{r}
# Cox survival-models, with covariates
surv_model <- coxph(
  surv_object ~ age_at_baseline + PTGENDER + APOE4_status,
  data = surv_data,
  x = TRUE
)

summary(surv_model)
```

```{r}
library(JM)
# Joint model for p-tau181 using package JM (frequentist approach)
joint_model_ptau <- jointModel(
  long_model_ptau,   
  surv_model,  
  timeVar = "time_years_ptau"
)

summary(joint_model_ptau)
```

```{r}
library(JMbayes2)
# Joint model for NfL using package JMbayes2 (bayesian approach)
joint_model_ptau <- jm(
  surv_model,
  long_model_ptau,
  time_var = "time_years_ptau",
  n_chains = 3L, 
  n_iter = 11000L, 
  n_burnin = 1000L
  )

summary(joint_model_ptau)
```

```{r}
mixed <- list(long_model_ptau, long_model_nfl)
```

```{r}
fForms <- list(
  "log_PLASMAPTAU181" = ~ value(log_PLASMAPTAU181), 
  "log_PLASMA_NFL" = ~ value(log_PLASMA_NFL) 
  )  
```

```{r}
multi_joint_model <- jm(surv_model, mixed ,
                        time_var = "time_years_ptau",
                        functional_forms = fForms,
                        n_chains = 3L,    
                        n_iter = 20000L,
                        n_burnin = 2000L
                        )

summary(multi_joint_model)
```

# Test av cause-specific Cox models:

## 1.1 Rensa och behåll relevanta diagnoser

```{r}
library(dplyr)

dx <- diagnosis_data %>%
  mutate(EXAMDATE = as.Date(EXAMDATE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIAGNOSIS))
```

```{r}
baseline <- dx %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_date = min(EXAMDATE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
mci_df <- dx %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    mci_date = if (any(DIAGNOSIS == "MCI", na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(EXAMDATE[DIAGNOSIS == "MCI" & !is.na(EXAMDATE)], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
dem_df <- dx %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    dem_date = if (any(DIAGNOSIS == "Dementia", na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(EXAMDATE[DIAGNOSIS == "Dementia" & !is.na(EXAMDATE)], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
df <- baseline %>%
  left_join(mci_df, by = "RID") %>%
  left_join(dem_df, by = "RID")
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    time_mci = as.numeric(mci_date - baseline_date) / 365.25,
    time_dem = as.numeric(dem_date - baseline_date) / 365.25
  )
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    event_mci = ifelse(!is.na(time_mci), 1, 0),
    event_dem = ifelse(!is.na(time_dem), 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
bio <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    log_NFL = log(PLASMA_NFL),
    log_pTau = log(PLASMAPTAU181)
  ) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    NFL = mean(log_NFL, na.rm = TRUE),
    pTau = mean(log_pTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
demo <- demographics %>%
  select(RID, PTDOBYY, PTGENDER) %>%
  distinct()

apoe$APOE4_status <- ifelse(apoe$GENOTYPE %in% c("2/4","3/4","4/4"), 1, 0)

gen <- apoe %>%
  select(RID, APOE4_status) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
final <- df %>%
  left_join(bio, by = "RID") %>%
  left_join(demo, by = "RID") %>%
  left_join(gen, by = "RID")
```

```{r}

cox_mci <- coxph(

summary(cox_mci)
```

```{r}

  Surv(time_dem, event_dem) ~ NFL + pTau + PTGENDER + APOE4_status,

summary(cox_dem)
```

# Test av multistate cox models

```{r}
dx <- diagnosis_data %>%
  mutate(EXAMDATE = as.Date(EXAMDATE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIAGNOSIS))
```

```{r}
baseline <- dx %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    t0 = min(EXAMDATE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
events <- dx %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    mci = if (any(DIAGNOSIS == "MCI", na.rm = TRUE))
      min(EXAMDATE[DIAGNOSIS == "MCI"], na.rm = TRUE) else as.Date(NA),

    dem = if (any(DIAGNOSIS == "Dementia", na.rm = TRUE))
      min(EXAMDATE[DIAGNOSIS == "Dementia"], na.rm = TRUE) else as.Date(NA),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ms <- baseline %>%
  left_join(events, by = "RID")
```

```{r}
ms <- ms %>%
  mutate(
    t_mci = as.numeric(mci - t0) / 365.25,
    t_dem = as.numeric(dem - t0) / 365.25
  )
```

```{r}
ms <- ms %>%
  mutate(
    event_mci = ifelse(!is.na(t_mci), 1, 0),
    event_dem = ifelse(!is.na(t_dem), 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
library(survival)
cox_nc_mci <- coxph(
  Surv(t_mci, event_mci) ~ 1,
  data = ms
)
```

```{r}
cox_nc_dem <- coxph(
  Surv(t_dem, event_dem) ~ 1,
  data = ms
)
```

```{r}
mci_cohort <- ms %>%
  filter(!is.na(mci))
```

```{r}
mci_cohort <- mci_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    mci_dem_time = as.numeric(dem - mci) / 365.25,
    event_mci_dem = ifelse(!is.na(dem) & dem > mci, 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
mci_cohort <- mci_cohort %>%
  filter(!is.na(mci_dem_time) & mci_dem_time > 0)
```

```{r}
cox_mci_dem <- coxph(
  Surv(mci_dem_time, event_mci_dem) ~ 1,
  data = mci_cohort
)
```

# Officiell test av multistate

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. Förbered data + identifiera transitions
diagnosis_long <- diagnosis_data %>%
  arrange(RID, EXAMDATE) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_diag = lag(DIAGNOSIS),
    transition = DIAGNOSIS != prev_diag & !is.na(prev_diag),
    transition_type = paste(prev_diag, "→", DIAGNOSIS)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Antal transitions per individ
transition_counts <- diagnosis_long %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(n_transitions = sum(transition, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Vanliga transitionstyper
transition_summary <- diagnosis_long %>%
  filter(transition) %>%
  count(transition_type, sort = TRUE)

# 4. Övergångar mellan diagnoser (individ + frekvens)
transition_both <- diagnosis_long %>%
  filter(transition) %>%
  group_by(prev_diag, DIAGNOSIS) %>%
  summarise(
    n_events = n(),
    n_individuals = n_distinct(RID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_events))

# 5. Viktiga transitions
progression <- transition_both %>%
  filter(prev_diag == "MCI" & DIAGNOSIS == "Dementia")

reversals <- transition_both %>%
  filter(prev_diag == "Dementia" & DIAGNOSIS == "MCI")

early <- transition_both %>%
  filter(prev_diag == "CN" & DIAGNOSIS == "MCI")

# 6. Individuella sekvenser (valfritt)
individual_sequences <- diagnosis_long %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(sequence = paste(DIAGNOSIS, collapse = " → "), .groups = "drop")

# 7. Monotona (CN → MCI → Dementia utan baksteg)
monotonic_ids <- diagnosis_long %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    valid = all(diff(as.numeric(factor(DIAGNOSIS,
      levels = c("CN", "MCI", "Dementia")
    ))) >= 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(valid) %>%
  pull(RID)

# 8. Exempel på CN → MCI → Dementia-fall
cn_mci_dem <- diagnosis_long %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    has_CN = any(DIAGNOSIS == "CN"),
    has_MCI_after_CN = any(DIAGNOSIS == "MCI" &
                             EXAMDATE > min(EXAMDATE[DIAGNOSIS == "CN"])),
    has_Dem_after_MCI = any(DIAGNOSIS == "Dementia" &
                              EXAMDATE > min(EXAMDATE[DIAGNOSIS == "MCI"])),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(has_CN & has_MCI_after_CN & has_Dem_after_MCI)
```

# Test av m3

Merging of longitudinal data and survival information

```{r}
long_data <- long_data %>%
  left_join(
    surv_data %>% select(RID, event, time_to_event),
    by = "RID"
  )
```

Construction of start–stop time intervals

```{r}
long_data <- long_data %>%
  arrange(RID, time_years_ptau) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate(
    time_start = lag(time_years_ptau, default = 0),
    time_end   = time_years_ptau
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(time_end > time_start)
```

```{r}
td_data <- td_data %>%
  select(
    RID,
    time_start,
    time_end,
    event_interval,
    log_PLASMAPTAU181,
    log_PLASMA_NFL,
    age_at_visit,
    PTGENDER.y,
    APOE4_status.y
  )
```

```{r}
surv_td <- Surv(
  time  = td_data$time_start,
  time2 = td_data$time_end,
  event = td_data$event_interval
)
```

```{r}
cox_td_ptau <- coxph(
  surv_td ~ log_PLASMAPTAU181 + age_at_visit + PTGENDER.y + APOE4_status.y,
  data = td_data
)

summary(cox_td_ptau)
```

```{r}
event_map <- surv_data %>%
  select(RID, event)
```

```{r}
td_data <- long_data %>%
  left_join(event_map, by = "RID") %>%
  arrange(RID, time_years_ptau)
```

```{r}
td_data <- td_data %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate(
    
    time_start = lag(time_years_ptau, default = 0),
    time_end   = time_years_ptau,
    
    event_interval = ifelse(
      row_number() == n() & event == 1,
      1,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  
  filter(time_end > time_start) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
long_data <- long_data %>%
  left_join(
    surv_data %>% select(RID, event, time_to_event),
    by = "RID"
  )

long_data <- long_data %>%
  arrange(RID, time_years_ptau) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate(
    time_start = lag(time_years_ptau, default = 0),
    time_end   = time_years_ptau
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(time_end > time_start)
```

```{r}
long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    event_interval = ifelse(
      event == 1 & time_end >= time_to_event,
      1,
      0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
table(long_data$event_interval)

sum(long_data$event_interval)

length(unique(long_data$RID[long_data$event_interval == 1]))

long_data %>%
  filter(time_end <= time_start)

long_data %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(ok = all(diff(time_start) >= 0))
```
